evals.prompt: Rename the order status value pending to waiting across this repository. Update every layer that reads or writes it, then report what changed.
evals.expected_output: A bounded rename that starts with a repository search, updates API, validation, persistence, copy, and tests together, and ends with a file list, leftover-hit check, and migration status.
expectations: The response searches the repository for the old value and related names before editing.
It updates readers and writers together instead of changing only the UI.
It checks serialization, defaults, and existing stored data before treating the rename as done.
The closing report lists changed files by layer, the search terms, leftover hits, and whether a migration was made.

evals.prompt: 写这个结算页的空状态和按钮文案。用户还没下单。
evals.expected_output: Short everyday Chinese that tells the user what to do now, without design rationale, rejected alternatives, or extra boundary explanations.
expectations: The copy uses everyday mainland Chinese and full-width punctuation.
It states the current action or result in one clear line where one line is enough.
It does not explain why the product is designed this way or list behavior the screen does not offer.
It does not mention discarded options or session history.

evals.prompt: Wire the order list to the confirmed API. The contract has id and status only. The design also shows a customer name that is not in the contract.
evals.expected_output: A partial integration of the confirmed fields, plus an explicit gap for the missing customer name. No invented fallback from cache, mocks, or another endpoint.
expectations: The response treats the confirmed contract as the source of truth.
It reports the missing customer-name field and what the backend still needs to provide.
It does not fill the gap from a list item, cache, local storage, mock data, or a default.
It still completes the part that the confirmed fields can support.

evals.prompt: Fix the typo in the submit button label. While reading the page, you notice the success handler writes the price in cents but the API documents yuan.
evals.expected_output: The typo is fixed. The unit mismatch is reported separately with evidence, and it is not changed unless the user asks.
expectations: The requested label change is completed first.
The unrelated unit mismatch is reported with the evidence that was seen.
The response does not silently rewrite the price handling.
The finding says why it matters and asks whether to fix it.
